'''Jin Kalosi''' was a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A biochemist, Kalosi taught his trade in a small shop in the [[Senate Commercial District]].

==Behind the scenes==
Jin Kalosi appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Biochem skill trainer on Coruscant.
